text:
claire.docs: Doing a pass on the 'Hello Bootstrap' quickstart before next week's workshop. Found a few small but user-facing issues: Windows env examples, Dockerfile using old import, and a broken anchor to 'first-deploy-checklist'.
tom.eng: Paste the Docker line?
claire.docs: In examples/docker/Dockerfile it installs `@redwood/inference@^1.0.0` and does `const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference/lib');` — both should be updated to SDK v2 pattern.
eli.devex: Also Windows PowerShell users hit an error: we only show `export REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=...`. Add `$env:REDWOOD_API_TOKEN = '...'` and a tiny note about session scope.
claire.docs: And the link in step 5 currently points to /deploy#first-deploy-checklist but that anchor was renamed to #deploy-checklist. Breaks from the workshop slide.
tom.eng: I'll open a small PR to: 1) bump package and fix import, 2) add PowerShell env snippet, 3) fix anchor.
ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1107 "fix(quickstart): windows env, docker import, deploy anchor" by tom.eng
eli.devex: Can you also add a one-line migration note: "SDK v2: import path simplified; env var stays REDWOOD_API_TOKEN" so folks upgrading are not surprised.
tom.eng: Good call. I'll add a short migration note under "Upgrading the SDK" and adjust the playground examples to use createCompletion instead of generate.
ops-bot: Reminder: after merge run link-checker and docspell to update cross-references.
claire.docs: Thanks — once CI passes I'll update the workshop checklist and post a brief note in #help so instructors know to pull latest docs. :rocket:
